title: When the Radiators Turns
author: Jude Iversen
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
